summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`. When invoked on `npm install`, setup.mjs attempts to run a local `bun` binary against the sibling file `math_init.js`; if `bun` is not present, it downloads a platform-specific Bun release from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts the binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it on `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line file with obfuscator.io-style transforms (hex-named identifiers, a large numeric/string array, a string-array rotation function, and a custom-alphabet character decoder) and is not exported by the library. The advertised module content is a trivial `export default 'John'` test export, which has no purpose alignment with fetching a second runtime and executing an opaque bundled script at install time. setup.mjs itself uses hex-renamed imports (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and encoded string-lookup objects hiding literal commands and paths such as `--version`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, `bun`, `bun.exe` — deliberate concealment of the install-time chain rather than incidental minification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
